headline: Escalating US-Iran conflict pushes Strait of Hormuz to brink of blockade, triggering critical helium shortage for semiconductors.
summary: The intensifying three-week US-Iran conflict is days away from a Strait of Hormuz blockade, threatening global oil supplies and potentially crippling Taiwan's critical semiconductor industry. Concurrently, the war has created an immediate helium shortage, directly impacting semiconductor manufacturing and the operational resilience of global data centers powering AI infrastructure.
